1719|bf4c7bb7.name: Warden Thelwater
1719|bf4c7bb7.text: Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!

313|be6b48f2.name: Theocritus
313|be6b48f2.text:
Welcome to the Tower of Azora, young $C.  I am Theocritus.

Do you have business with me?  Or...do I have business with you, perhaps?

5511|cbb91364.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|cbb91364.text: I said ye had the blood of a blacksmith in ye, and I was right. Go to Ironforge, to The Great Forge, and find yerself a Dwarven smith by the name of Bengus Deepforge. My teacher, and one of the greatest smiths I've ever known.

1199-progress.name: Argent Guard Manados
1199-progress.text:
Blackfathom Deeps was once an ancient night elf temple. It once housed a most powerful moonwell. Who knows what evil brews there now at the hands of the Twilight's Hammer.

Have you made any progress in ridding their presence?
1199-progress.title: Twilight Falls

1200-progress.name: Dawnwatcher Selgorm
1200-progress.text:
Time is a precious commodity, $c.

My role here in Darnassus is to ensure that the Argent Dawn thrives and that the evil forces encroaching upon Kalimdor are thwarted.

State your business quickly or be on your way.
1200-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

1275-progress.name: Gershala Nightwhisper
1275-progress.text:
Once I have enough samples to study, my true work can begin. With the corrupted brain stems of both the satyr and naga of Blackfathom Deeps I can try to draw a correlation between the mutations.

Perhaps with that gained knowledge we can prevent the blood elves from delving deeper into deformity and evil.
1275-progress.title: Researching the Corruption

1654-progress.name: Jordan Stilwell
1654-progress.text:
The items you're seeking will be difficult to acquire, but I can assure you, the weapon I will craft for you will be worth the effort.

It will be my finest work to date, and only a small payment for the service you've done me.
1654-progress.title: The Test of Righteousness

178-progress.name: Theocritus
178-progress.text: I spoke to you through a pendant, you say?  Hmm...give it to me, so that I might study it.
178-progress.title: Theocritus' Retrieval

971-progress.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
971-progress.text: The journey to Ashenvale is long, and your task is not easy.  But if you get me the manuscript, $N...then your reward will be great.
971-progress.title: Knowledge in the Deeps
